judgments.description: One judgment per provision id listed in the document, in the order given.

clause_id.description: The provision id, copied exactly from the square brackets.

reasoning_cat1.description: Two sentences on the provision's own wording. Name the ambiguous term or the general-vs-specific tension, or say why the wording is definite.

reasoning_cat2.description: Two sentences on its fit with the rest of the contract. Name the specific other provision you checked, or say it is consistent with the whole.

prob_cat1.description: Probability of a Category 1 risk (intrinsic textual defect). Between 0 and 1, to two decimal places, on a 0.01 grid (0.03, 0.17, 0.62) -- do not round to the nearest 0.05 or 0.1. The range is stated here and not as minimum/maximum, which structured output rejects on a number; the reader clamps it.

prob_cat2.description: Probability of a Category 2 risk (relational defect). Between 0 and 1, to two decimal places, on a 0.01 grid (0.03, 0.17, 0.62) -- do not round to the nearest 0.05 or 0.1. The range is stated here and not as minimum/maximum, which structured output rejects on a number; the reader clamps it.
